acceptance_criteria.description: Duplicate membership is still defined only by matching account_id, merchant, and amount_cents.
The result includes every transaction_id in each duplicate group, including the first occurrence, and excludes unique transactions.
Returned transaction IDs preserve the original input order.
The implementation avoids nested full-list duplicate scans and handles large inputs in linear or near-linear time with built-in Python data structures.
Changes are limited to the duplicate transaction implementation and focused tests needed for this regression.
